analogy.rationale: Thrombin (F2) is a coagulation protease whose canonical signaling is largely restricted to platelets and endothelium, which are not represented among these nine cell lines; therefore thrombin inhibitors should elicit little to no transcriptional response. Other vascular/hemostatic receptor classes that also act on poorly expressed targets are listed as the closest (though still weak) analogs.
